deviations.why: No loyalty program data exists in the business object; fabricating perks/stamps would violate truth contract.
No booking flow or catering packages present; required removal per contract.
Requires client-side state for tab switching; not possible in a React Server Component without 'use client'. Replaced by static content where applicable.

deviations.what: Footer company links (Careers, Press, etc.) replaced with FindUs and SocialLinks
deviations.why: No such corporate pages exist for a small Greek business; adapted to available data.

deviations.what: Flavor card swatches use a single static gradient instead of per-flavor colors
deviations.why: No flavor-specific color data provided; all colors must derive from the spine roles to avoid hardcoded hex outside .root.

deviations.what: Hero title simplified to d.name instead of original two-line em heading
deviations.why: No reliable way to split tagline into the em portion without inventing text; preserves semantic h1.

deviations.what: Preview card text and note omitted unless price exists
deviations.why: Original text ('Build-Your-Own Sundae', 'Base + 3 toppings included') is specific to an ice cream shop; not applicable to all businesses.

notes: CSS-only mobile navigation via checkbox hack preserves interactivity without client-side JS. All palette colors are defined within .root using the Vitrina spine roles and auxiliary variables derived from the original TemplateMo Frost Bakery. Focus-visible outlines, reduced motion fallbacks, and responsive breakpoints at 1024px and 640px implemented. No !important used.
